import semver
import sys

# Test R1: No args should print help and return exit code 2
print('=== R1: No args ===')
rc = semver.main([])
assert rc == 2, f'Expected exit code 2, got {rc}'
print(f'Return code: {rc} ✓')

# Test R1: bump subcommand without specific args should print help and exit gracefully
print()
print('=== R1: bump subcommand without specific args ===')
rc = semver.main(['bump'])
# This prints help and returns 0 (graceful exit)
print(f'Return code: {rc} ✓')

# Test R3: isvalid method
print()
print('=== R3: isvalid method ===')
assert semver.VersionInfo.isvalid('1.2.3') == True
assert semver.VersionInfo.isvalid('invalid') == False
assert semver.VersionInfo.isvalid('1.2') == False
assert semver.VersionInfo.isvalid('1.2.3-rc.1+build.1') == True
print('isvalid works correctly ✓')

# Test check subcommand via CLI
print()
print('=== R3: check subcommand ===')
semver.main(['check', '1.2.3'])  # Should print 'valid'
semver.main(['check', 'invalid'])  # Should print 'invalid'
print('check subcommand works ✓')

# Test R4: Public API functions exist
print()
print('=== R4: Public functions ===')
assert hasattr(semver, 'cmd_bump')
assert hasattr(semver, 'cmd_check')
assert hasattr(semver, 'cmd_compare')
assert callable(semver.cmd_bump)
assert callable(semver.cmd_check)
assert callable(semver.cmd_compare)
print('Public functions exposed correctly ✓')

# Test public functions work
from argparse import Namespace
args = Namespace(which='bump', bump='major', version='1.2.3')
result = semver.cmd_bump(args)
assert result == '2.0.0', f'Expected 2.0.0, got {result}'
print(f'cmd_bump({args}) = {result} ✓')

args = Namespace(which='compare', version1='1.2.3', version2='2.1.3')
result = semver.cmd_compare(args)
assert result == '-1', f'Expected -1, got {result}'
print(f'cmd_compare({args}) = {result} ✓')

args = Namespace(which='check', version='1.2.3')
result = semver.cmd_check(args)
assert result == 'valid', f'Expected valid, got {result}'
print(f'cmd_check({args}) = {result} ✓')

# Test createparser, finalize_version, process still work
print()
print('=== Other functions ===')
parser = semver.createparser()
assert parser is not None
print('createparser works ✓')

result = semver.finalize_version('1.2.3-rc.5')
assert result == '1.2.3', f'Expected 1.2.3, got {result}'
print(f'finalize_version(\"1.2.3-rc.5\") = {result} ✓')

args = Namespace(which='bump', bump='minor', version='1.2.3')
result = semver.process(args)
assert result == '1.3.0', f'Expected 1.3.0, got {result}'
print(f'process(bump minor 1.2.3) = {result} ✓')

print()
print('ALL TESTS PASSED ✓')
" 2>&1
